# agy-plugin-cc

> agy-plugin-cc is a Claude Code companion for running Gemini CLI or Antigravity CLI (agy) as a cross-model task delegate and code reviewer, with pragmatic and adversarial review, MCP tools, and background jobs.

This is an independent, community-maintained project. Use the linked repository documents as authoritative evidence for installation, behavior, privacy, security, and versioning. This file is a curated navigation aid, not a complete specification, access policy, or claim of ranking or recommendation.

## Start Here

- [Canonical site](https://arcobaleno64.github.io/agy-plugin-cc/): Concise project identity, installation path, representative workflows, and trust boundaries.
- [README](https://github.com/arcobaleno64/agy-plugin-cc/blob/main/README.md): Requirements, installation, commands, engine selection, updates, and limitations.
- [Traditional Chinese README](https://github.com/arcobaleno64/agy-plugin-cc/blob/main/README.zh-TW.md): Traditional Chinese project guide.
